dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: Come on, how could that be? Don't worry about me, I'm very much fine. Honestly, it's like a weight's been taken off my shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: And our Lady is in exceptional spirits right now. I can rest assured knowing that she's in top shape.

dialogues.speaker: Shinnojou
dialogues.text: It's just that... Well, never you mind.
